Time-locked staking stops bulk forgery. First, lock 150 units for 20 epochs. A timber audit binds the stake to one credential.

Then, honest work unlocks 5% each epoch. A crystal checkpoint verifies activity every 5 epochs. Finally, forgery forfeits 60% and resets the timer.

Cost math: 1,000 clones lock 150,000 units. A 30% forgery rate loses 27,000 to slashing. The meadow ledger publishes every lock. Forgery loses money.
